product_metadata.title: Adjustable Plastic Curtain Rod Extendable Curtain Rods for Window Cupboard Bars Tension Rods Curtain Rail Pole Self Adhesive Curtain Rod for Home Bathroom Hotel, 15.7-27.5 Inch (White, 2)
features: What you will get: the package contains 2 pieces of white adjustable curtain rods, along with 6 pieces of self adhesive curtain rod hooks, sufficient quantity to meet your daily use, replacement and sharing with others

Measurement: each extendable curtain rod measures about 40 cm/ 15.7 inch in length under normal condition, and it measures about 70 cm/ 27.5 inch in length under extension; The size of each curtain rod hook is about 2.8 x 1.9 cm/ 1.1 x 0.75 inch, please confirm the size before ordering

Reliable material: the cupboard bar tension rod and rod hook are made of quality plastic, they are durable, sturdy, not easy to be broken or fall off, can serve you for a long time, convenient and practical, you can use them in your bedroom, living room, kitchen, etc.

Simple installation: there is a small hole at the ends of each adjustable plastic curtain rod for inserting the rod hook, and the hook is self adhesive for easy securing on the wall, window or cupboard, no drill or screw needed, simple and convenient

Wide rang of use: these adjustable curtain poles can be applied for all kinds of occasions, such as home, office, hotel, party, garden, etc., you can use them for net curtain, cupboard and more; Attention: these self adhesive curtain rod hooks are small, please do not hang too heavy objects on them
